note: These assignments repair inherited 1830 province centroids that fall outside their named region or combine island groups too coarse for direct point-in-polygon ownership. They are gameplay projections, not new historical boundary evidence.

overrides.notes: Araucania inherits a polar centroid. The named province is projected to Chile in the coarse 1936 mesh.
Cape Colony inherits a polar centroid. Its coarse 1936 province is projected to the Union of South Africa.
The inherited Indian Ocean grouping lacks a usable island centroid. It is projected to British Mauritius for the preview mesh.
Patagonia Meridional inherits a polar centroid and is projected to Argentina, matching the inherited province identity.
The South Atlantic island grouping has no single reviewed dependency polygon at this resolution. It is projected to the United Kingdom for preview gameplay.
Western Polynesia combines several islands and inherits a polar centroid. It is projected to the British Western Pacific Territories for the preview mesh.
The Scottish Highlands centroid is displaced into the North Atlantic and is projected to the United Kingdom.
Fiji has a displaced inherited centroid and is projected to the Colony of Fiji.
Nordnorge has an offshore high-latitude centroid and is projected to Norway.
Macaronesia combines multiple archipelagos. The inherited Portuguese grouping is retained for preview gameplay and remains a documented coarse projection.
